task.title: Find a note left for you
task.shortdesc: guides you to a note with hot-and-cold hints. It never shows a distance or a map.

step.cmd: Tap the name left you something notification, or open the Notes tab.
Head toward the place in the hint while the note updates.
step.info: It moves from Far away to Getting closer to Very close.

step.cmd: When it says You're here, tap to open, tap the note.

taskbody.result: The note opens. An opened note is kept on this phone for 30 days.
taskbody.tasktroubleshooting: If you see Can't tell where you are right now. Step outside or stand by a window., your phone doesn't have a good location reading yet.
